service.description: How a record type keeps its files: the content entity of get#RecordLinkInfo (info, its contentEntity map) with its primary key fields, the enumeration type of its type field, and the Mantle service that creates a row and saves its file (createService, null for Facility, which has no pair: its file is written here). Null contentType for a record type without a content entity.

service.description: The record's files, newest first: name, type (the content type enumeration's description), description, who added it and when, its size and media type, whether it previews inline (raster images and PDF), whether the user may remove it; and the type options of the record's content type enumeration for the upload. hasContent is false for a record type without a content entity. limit caps the rows (fileCount is all of them).

One file of the record by its contentKey: the content row, which must be the record's, its location and file name, and whether it may show inline (a raster image or a PDF; anything else, SVG and HTML among them, only downloads, so no script of an uploaded file runs in the app's origin).

Adds files to a record: for each uploaded file (contentFile, one or a list) a content row of the record's type with contentTypeEnumId and description, through the record type's Mantle create#<X>Content (the 13 types with a create and save pair; Facility's FacilityContent row and file are written here). Each file stands alone: one that fails is logged and named in failedList, and the others are kept. A record type without a content entity, or a record the user may not see, is refused.

parameter.name: contentFile
parameter.description: An uploaded file or a list of them

service.description: Removes a file from a record: its content row, then the file itself (a file that cannot be deleted is logged; the row is gone). Only the user who added it, or a user the record's authorization lets update the record.
